title: TWITTER Gravel V3 RS 24-speed manufacturer frame-weight recheck
publisher: TWITTER / Shenzhen First Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Current manufacturer table identifies the T47 RS-24S hydraulic alloy-wheel configuration and claims 9.9 kg for the complete bike, with 700×40C fitted. It publishes no bare-frame mass. The separate approximately 1,150 g unpainted size-M store claim accompanies a BB86 listing and cannot be transferred to this T47 build.
